name: Bridgeport YMCA Summer Day Camp
description_short: A traditional YMCA day camp at the Bridgeport YMCA for children entering kindergarten through 9th grade, grouped by grade. In 2026 it ran in 9 weekly sessions, June 22 to August 21, from 8:00 am to 4:00 pm, with breakfast, lunch and snack provided and paid after care until 5:30 pm. Activities include arts and crafts, sports, swimming and STEM projects.
special_needs_notes: The Y works with children of all abilities. If your child needs social, behavioral or medical accommodations, contact the Camp Director. An Individual Care Plan and Medicine Authorization form may be required.
refund_policy_summary: The $50 registration fee per camper and the $50 deposit per camper per week are non-refundable and non-transferable.
